scope: Static implementation versus GATE_SPEC.json and PROTOCOL.md; no synthetic tests or numerical experiments run

findings.finding: Identical omission in baseline/after/full object lists passes set equality; no nonempty/cardinality check against registered cohort counts precedes relation aggregation. Missing weak observations can thus disappear from both all-qualified estimates and eligible source denominator.
findings.required_fix: Before units or gate calculation, require each registered pair/role frozen weak and background counts to be positive, and object-list cardinalities for weak/background/reliable in baseline plus all conditions to match frozen manifest cohort counts. Treat any mismatch as execution failure, never a zero or omitted eligible source.
findings.resolution: validate_frozen_cohorts now runs before units/gate construction. It checks frozen cohort SHA/index/counts and eligibility, exact weak/reliable/background ID sets in baseline and all three conditions, original object metadata, and fixed background ROI. Equal omissions now raise an execution error before authorization rather than shrink denominators.

passed_checks: Physical object/frame duplicate window contexts averaged within pair before track averaging.
Per-track across-pair estimates receive equal pair weight; then source means give each trusted trajectory equal weight and cross-source median gives equal source weight.
Background and uncertain reliable proxies follow declared separate hierarchy; uncertain identities do not supply trusted-trajectory evidence.
Same pair must have at least one beneficial weak track and the same cost path on both update and observer; different removals/relations/costs are not pooled.
Supporting observer sources must be at least two and a strict majority of eligible weak observer sources.
All qualified track effects, including negatives, are included in relation-level benefit; positive subsets serve only localized chain evidence.
Empty cost cohort fails cost path; no missing cost is replaced by zero.
Original FP32 margin is preserved; thresholds match fixed old epsilon multipliers.
Every registered pair/role remains anchored to nonempty frozen weak/background cohorts; baseline and all conditions must retain every original weak, reliable and background identity.
Frozen cohort guard runs before all unit/source calculations and decisions; a missing cohort cannot enter a smaller eligible-source denominator.
limits: Static review does not establish empirical benefit, cost, statistical significance or successful runtime completion.
No synthetic numerical tests were repeated for this review.
